name: Fel Cone
summary: Beneath Teldrassil's boughs, Fel Cones carry corruption into the forest. Night elf defenders put the pods to use against nearby tricksters.

sections.title: Blight in the Canopy
sections.body: Beneath Teldrassil's boughs, Fel Cones show that corruption has reached the young tree. Gnarled and fallen, the pine cones billow foul green smoke. They lie scattered just east of Dolanaar. Tainted magic has warped the surrounding flora, and the pods are dangerous to touch or eat without caution.

sections.title: A Bitter Medicine
sections.body: Zenn Foulhoof is a satyr who tricks passersby into doing his bidding. When travelers fall for his wiles, Syral Bladeleaf and the Sentinels direct them to gather Fel Cones and offer them to Foulhoof as an innocent snack. The corruption in a cone briefly transforms the satyr into a harmless frog.

faq.answer: A Fel Cone is a corrupted pine cone that falls from Teldrassil's boughs. Tainted by unnatural magic, it gives off eerie green smoke and holds volatile, transformative power.

faq.q: Where can Fel Cones be found?
faq.answer: Fel Cones lie on the forest floor beneath the trees just east of Dolanaar, in Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why does the Council of the Forest want them collected?
faq.answer: If you helped Zenn Foulhoof harm nature's creatures without knowing it, the Council of the Forest gives you a chance to make amends. They tell you to gather Fel Cones and trick Zenn into eating them as a lesson.

faq.q: What happens when someone eats a Fel Cone?
faq.answer: The Council of the Forest means the cones to teach Zenn Foulhoof a lesson. He is expected to mistake one for a harmless snack.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know Fel Cones signal sickness deep within Teldrassil's roots. Even the young World Tree is not safe from demonic corruption.
As a druid, you see wholesome woodland seed pods become smoking fel remnants. Their corruption shows how fragile Teldrassil's balance is.
